goal: Measure correct useful completions during bounded mixed local inference while preserving host responsiveness.
baseline: Required separate measured report with identical fixture, grader, model digests, host identity and workload budget.
held_out: None: these public synthetic fixtures are development probes, not a held-out semantic or release evaluation.
decision_rule: Never emit ACCEPT from this public probe. Emit MEASURED_IMPROVEMENT only for comparable complete non-smoke reports with at least three trials, improved primary KPI and all measured guards passing; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, NOT_COMPARABLE, or NO_MEASURED_IMPROVEMENT. Independent held-out validation is required for promotion.
limitations: health latency measures the control plane, not desktop responsiveness
process wake jitter is a local scheduling proxy, not UI latency
exact and JSON grading do not establish general semantic quality
three trials improve repeatability but do not prove statistical significance
keep_alive=0 includes loading and unloading cost and does not model warm interactive sessions
